verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo top-left, the badge top-right and a big two-line headline with a clear order. But the shoe is now larger than its green circle and sits off-centre over it, losing the original's framed-disc look. 'Full review inside.' is also jammed under the sole with little bottom margin. B's layout is broken. The NEW VIDEO badge and logo share one row in swapped, arbitrary positions. The headline shrank and wraps awkwardly ('...on 100 / marathons'). The green circle has come apart from the shoe and drifts to the bottom-right, leaving a lopsided composition with dead space on the left.
